name: Cartridge Player
description: Slide a labelled NFC cartridge into the player to start its activity, and pull it out to stop

inserted.title: Cartridge inserted
inserted.description: A cartridge went into the player and its activity was resolved

activityId.description: The activity it's labelled with; null for an unlabelled cartridge

result.description: What happened: started or marked its activity, resumed one already live, or nothing because it's unlabelled (unknown), its activity was deleted (orphan) or archived, or starting failed (error)

ejected.title: Cartridge ejected
ejected.description: A cartridge came out of the player; the session it started or took over was ended if it was still live

activityId.description: The activity it was in the player as; null for an unlabelled cartridge

durationMs.description: How long its session ran while it was in, in milliseconds; null when it ran none

player.title: Player
player.description: Whether the player is reachable, and which one: the one whose slot changed last or that was set up last

online.description: Heard from within the last 75 seconds; null when that isn't known: before any player is heard, and while a player hasn't reported yet since the plugin started (for at most 75 seconds)

lastHeardAt.description: When it was last heard from (ISO 8601), to within 15 minutes while it's online

deviceId.description: The player's id, like cp-a1b2c3; null before any player is heard

name.description: The name it shows on its setup network, like Cartridge-A1B2

reader.description: The NFC reader's health as the player last reported it; fault means it can't tell whether a cartridge is in

slot.title: Slot
slot.description: What is in the player's slot and what it's doing

phase.description: empty; playing (its session is live); marked (a point activity was marked when it went in); ready (labelled, nothing tracking); unknown (unlabelled); orphan or archived (its activity was deleted or archived); error (starting it failed)

tag.description: The cartridge's NFC UID, like 04:A2:3B:1C; null when the slot is empty

activityId.description: The activity it's in the player as; null when empty or unlabelled

sessionId.description: The session it started or adopted, which taking it out ends; null when there is none

since.description: When it went in (ISO 8601); null when the slot is empty

deviceId.description: The player it's in; null before any player is heard
